visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt with a small pink heart logo, is seen in a bright, well-lit kitchen. She is using a large kitchen knife to forcefully bang on a corn cob placed on a wooden cutting board, smiling cheerfully. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of a man's hands, wearing a black watch, demonstrating a technique where the knife is inserted into the corn and then rolled across the board to peel back the kernels. (3) A man in a black t-shirt and a New York Yankees cap stands behind the kitchen counter. He points at several pieces of corn that look mangled and messy on the cutting board, shaking his head. (4) The man demonstrates a second method by inserting the knife into the corn and then using his palm to strike the back of the blade, neatly splitting the cob. He then picks up a pair of large kitchen scissors and inserts them into the center of a cob to split it apart. (5) In the final phase, the man continues his demonstration with the scissors, showing how they split the corn core easily. He looks directly at the camera with a playful expression while finishing the task.
